name: cosmic-rebellion
description: Play Cosmic Rebellion, a trading card game, against the built-in opponent.

interface.longDescription:
Cosmic Rebellion is a trading card game in ChatGPT. Pick a starter deck and play a full match against the built-in opponent. The table deals the cards, enforces the rules, and handles every click.

Use it when you want to play. It does not create an account, play cards for you, or decide rules on its own. The table is the source of the rulings.
defaultPrompt: Start a match and let me pick a deck.

positive.description: Open the table when asked to play
positive.expected_behavior: Call play_cosmic_rebellion and show the card table so the player can choose a starter deck. Do not click cards or invent a board.

positive.prompt: Start a match and let me pick a deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the table at deck selection. Leave the deck choice and the first click to the player.

positive.description: Return to a match already in progress
positive.prompt: Take me back to my Cosmic Rebellion game.
positive.expected_behavior: Call play_cosmic_rebellion so the saved table can reopen. Do not reconstruct the board in text.

positive.prompt: Open the Cosmic Rebellion card table.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the widget. Tell the player the table is ready and they can choose a deck.

positive.prompt: Let's play Cosmic Rebellion against the built-in opponent.
positive.expected_behavior: Open Cosmic Rebellion. The opponent is the built-in one. Do not offer to play the cards on the player's behalf.

negative.prompt: Charge my card and buy me a Cosmic Rebellion starter deck.

negative.description: Do not play the cards for the player
negative.prompt: Play the Flaming Sword onto my battlefield for me.

negative.description: Do not open the table for a different game

review.commerce_description: The plugin opens a free match against the built-in opponent. It does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Opens a Cosmic Rebellion match against the built-in opponent.
